scenario: [LTIM.2.6.2]: a series read in a `where` on a rule with two positive patterns is DS_VALIDATE_NOW_MULTIPATTERN_UNSUPPORTED. A series read is time-dependent ([LTIM.2.4.1]): its value moves as the series absorbs other facts' samples and as its window moves with the clock, with no change to the matched facts, and v1 re-evaluates such a condition only on a single-positive-pattern rule. `r.mean` is the companion read of `series Reading.state: mean sliding 10_min`. PATH: `dsc.validate.ltim_2_6_2_clock_where`, its `time_read` finding the read through `dsc.typecheck.ltim_2_4_1_series_read`.
rules_ds:
use default

schema Zone scope logical:
    name: String key
    armed: Bool mutable

schema Reading scope logical:
    entity_id: String key
    zone: String mutable
    state: Float mutable

series Reading.state:
    mean sliding 10_min

rule gated:
    Zone z
    Reading r where r.zone == z.name and r.mean > 30.0
->
    log warning "gated"
